panel.project.title: Project
panel.inspector.title: Inspector
panel.inspector.empty: Select an item to inspect its properties.
view.fit.tooltip: Fit map: show the whole map
view.center.tooltip: Center selection: move the view to the selected object or tile
view.textures.tooltip: Show the ground and objects textured, or plain tiles with outlines. The 3D view always shows textures.
view.3d.tooltip: Look at and edit the map in 3D: right drag turns, middle drag moves, the wheel zooms.
view.routes.tooltip: Show the bus stops and the routes of the timetable lines in the view from above. Lines are listed in the project browser.
menu.edit.refit_terrain: Fit terrain to built roads again
menu.edit.test_junction: Create test junction from road profile
menu.edit.test_junction.tooltip: Makes a straight 12 m junction object in the profile chosen in the road tool, under Sceneryobjects\Mapforge in your OMSI installation, and starts placing it.
menu.edit.tee_junction: Create T junction from road profile
menu.edit.tee_junction.tooltip: Makes a T junction with rounded kerbs, pavements and lanes for every way through in the profile chosen in the road tool, and starts placing it.
menu.edit.cross_junction.tooltip: Makes a junction of four arms with rounded kerbs, pavements and lanes for every way through in the profile chosen in the road tool, and starts placing it.
menu.view.satellite.tooltip: Place the map on the Earth and load pictures from the air and terrain heights for its tiles, without any key, as openMapper does.
legend.title: Colours in the view from above
help.text.open_map: Select File, then Open OMSI map... to read a global.cfg directly from the OMSI installation.
help.text.save_project: Save map project as... stores a small project file that points back to this external global.cfg.
help.text.edit_object: With a project, click an object in the map or in the inspector list to edit its position and orientation. Edits are saved to the project's workspace; the original map is not changed.
help.text.library: Objects (3) opens the object library: browse the Sceneryobjects folders, the objects of this map or your favorites, click one and click into the map to place it. Del deletes the selected object unless other parts of the map still refer to it.
help.text.selection: Ctrl+click adds objects to the selection or removes them; Ctrl+drag on empty space selects all objects in a box. Dragging one selected object moves all of them. An object moved over a tile border moves into that tile.
help.text.export: Export to OMSI... writes the original map plus your edits as a separate map folder next to the original.
help.text.game_files: OMSI game files are read in place and are not bundled with the application.
menu.help.check_updates.tooltip: Look on GitHub for a newer release of MapWorks and install it
menu.help.report_bug.tooltip: Describe a problem and open it as a new issue on GitHub, with the log attached
export.title: Export to OMSI
export.description: Writes the original map plus the edits of this project as a separate map folder next to the original. The original map is not changed.
check.title: Map check
